title: Tenma Saki — A Year's Worth Of Thanks〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Humhumhuum♪
This looks just about done!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mom, the mochi for the soup's baked and ready! I'll start by giving Dad... Three!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you did a wonderful job with the baking.
Mind getting Tsukasa's bowl ready next?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Tsukasa's gonna want... Five?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Correct. I just received word from him, and he said he'll be home soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He went to see that show with Emu and the others today, right?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. He was very excited about it because the show's received praise for how it involves the audience.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What do you think it was about?
I'm gonna ask him all about it when he gets back♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I also wanna give him what I got at the New Year's sales... I hope he gets home soon.)
I'm back!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! Welcome back...!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Right on cue.
se_walk_men_006_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The man with super duper luck has returned!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Super duper luck...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! Would you like to know what I'm talking about, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The thing is, after the show ended, we visited a shrine by the theatre and drew fortunes together...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm calling myself super duper lucky because my fortune wasn't just a “great blessing”. I drew a “super great blessing”! I couldn't ask for a better way to start off the new year!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What...? That's amazing!
I didn't know any shrines had those!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I felt sublime in that moment...
I mean, it was clearly no ordinary fortune since it had a golden glow to it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not sure if that's the reason, but I can feel myself overflowing with power!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, you're gonna have to share some of that super duper luck with me this year♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
This blessing is proof that the Tenmas have another happy and prosperous year to look forward to!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Saki, were you able to buy those things you wanted? You went to the New Year's sales with Shiho, yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We got to check out a bunch of shops, and I got everything I wanted!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, also. There's something I wanna give you, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Give me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
Here, I got you a present!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What?! You got me a present?!
Can I open it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's... A water bottle!
Yes, not only is it lightweight, it looks like it can hold quite a lot... It's just what I need for when I practice!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And its blue body is studded in stars.
Almost like the night sky.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Its design is fit for a future star such as myself!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Guess what? Those stars...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I put them on your bottle!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaaaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You made this stellar night sky, Saki...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
Oh, they're even waterproof, so don't worry about them coming off!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They are?! You went through all this trouble just for me...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you, Saki...!
I shall cherish this forever!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it so much...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho actually helped me pick it out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She did?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
I know that you've been practicing super duper hard, so I wanted to get you something that shows my support for you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is when she suggested that I get you something you can use when you practice!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So that's how it went...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You put that much thought into this water bottle, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That means I'll be reminded of your support for me every time I use it! In other words, you'll be cheering me on...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You've been doing that for me, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For as long as I can remember!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait a second! If you're constantly giving me energy and I'm constantly giving you energy, then that means we can keep looping around to give each other an infinite amount of energy for as long as we live!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! That makes us like the most powerful siblings ever!

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Saki!
The mochi's getting huge!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh no...!
I forgot that I was making mochi for you, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You were making mochi for me, Saki?! In that case, I'll make some for you as well!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You will?
You're great at it, so I can't wait to have some!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! Just leave it to me!
The mochi I make for you is guaranteed to be delicious!
